images.filename: Langfossen Waterfall (Vaulaelva River) Etne Municipality Vestland County, Norway 2020-06-11. Tourist taking selfie sunny summer day, etc 00759.jpg
images.caption: The Langfossen Waterfall in Etne Municipality in Vestland county, Norway is located about 5 kilometres (3.1 mi) southwest of the village of Fjæra. The water falls down a towering mountain, a total distance of about 612 metres (2,008 ft) before the water leaps out into the Åkrafjorden fjord at the base of the mountain. European route E134 runs along the base of the waterfall, making access very easy. Photo taken in June 2020.
